Name: DGR 020 - EROSPOINT
Information:
**DGR 020 - EROSPOINT**

EROSPOINT was designed to hold back away from front-line units, suppressing opponents by overloading their senses with their eidomantic arrows, then causing the energy released from those arrows to build up and explode in a dramatic flash. These more elegant units were assigned to marksmen and dextrous pilots, who could best use their advanced speed and targeting systems.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The DGR makes two weapon attacks.

actions.name: DGR Pike
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Eidoglamor Arrow
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, range 600 ft., one target. Hit: 20 (2d12 + 7) piercing damage. The first time a target is hit by this attack each turn, they must make a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure the target is Charmed (or charmed (malfunction) if they are a construct) for 1 minute, and unable to take hostile action toward the DGR or its allies. A target charmed this way repeats the save at the end of each of their turns, ending the effect on a success. If the target was hit by a critical hit, they fail their saving throw automatically.

actions.name: Burst Stitch Cross
actions.description: The DGR causes energy residing within all of its charmed targets to detonate, ending the effect causing them to be charmed and make a DC 19 Dexterity saving throw, taking 23 (5d8) psychic damage and 23 (5d8) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much on a success.

bonus_actions.name: Burst Warp (Recharge 5-6)
bonus_actions.description: The DGR teleports to an unoccupied space it can see within 60 feet.

bonus_actions.name: Shock Fire Target
bonus_actions.description: The DGR gains advantage on the next ranged weapon attack it makes, even if it would otherwise have disadvantage, as long as its target is within 300 feet.
